address: 4 Soi Samakkhi 38, Samakkhi Road, Tha Sai, Mueang Nonthaburi, Nonthaburi, 11000, Thailand
bio: Fuss-free food, live seafood in tanks cooked to order and a speedy service have earned Chai Phochana its loyal following. The stir-fried squid comes with a rich, creamy salted egg yolk and spring onions. The spicy sour soup with giant catfish roes and vegetables is also tasty. Open till late, for night owls with a hunger pang, this is the place for you....
